title: New `a11y` demo-directive parser (happy + error paths) has no unit coverage; no parse_demo test exists at all
detail: P3 gap. Happy path is exercised by the 5 shipped demos via the harness gate; the malformed-input branches (bad palette name, bad scale, missing fields) are never driven anywhere.
recommended_fix: Add a small parse_demo test leg covering the a11y directive's accept + reject strings.

title: a11y_reduced + a11y_scale goldens have no presence/content oracle — only the 3 palette modes get palcheck scans
evidence:
modes := []rnd.Palette_Mode{.Deutan, .Protan, .Tritan}
--- grep a11y_reduced|a11y_scale harness/palcheck.odin: no matches
detail: P2 gap. The reduced-motion readability contract and the x1.50 scaled-chrome AC rely on T2 hash equality alone; nothing asserts the pinned-static ring/outline or the enlarged HUD pixels are present.
recommended_fix: Extend palcheck section 4 with reduced-motion presence (steady ring width pixels) and scale presence (HUD rect sample) scans.

title: Parity suite still never runs under any a11y mode or scale — the per-mode input-parity AC has no leg
location: harness/parity.odin (drive_parity/run_input_parity construct the view at defaults)
evidence:
pal := rnd.palette_load()
view.palette = &pal
rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)
--- grep ui_scale|reduced_motion|palette_apply_mode harness/parity.odin: no matches
detail: P1-family gap (AC-1 claims parity holds under every a11y mode). All 27 scenarios run at mode Off / motion on / x1.00; chip/row rects shift under x1.25/1.50.
recommended_fix: Drive the settings-panel + one world scenario per mode and per scale step.

title: x1.25 scale step and the 1152x648 min-window AC exercised by no golden, parity, or presence leg
evidence:
a11y scale 150
--- only 100 (implicit) and 150 paths exist in demos/ and harness/
detail: P2 gap. The middle step and the spec's min-window no-overlap AC are untested; hud_test pins rounding but not end-layout at 1152x648.
recommended_fix: Add a x1.25 golden demo and/or a 1152x648 layout leg.

title: palcheck routes the 48-vs-40 threshold on pr[0] color-VALUE equality, not pair identity
detail: P3 gap. A signal pair whose first color coincidentally equals a map token's RGBA gets the laxer 40 threshold; the oracle test cannot distinguish.
recommended_fix: Key the threshold on the pair's token indices, not color equality.

title: Machado matrices + thresholds duplicated Python/Odin with no cross-check; derive_a11y_palettes.py runs in no CI gate
detail: P3 gap. Palcheck (gated) keeps the shipped tables honest, but the derivation record itself can drift from the oracle silently.
recommended_fix: Add a CI leg that runs the script and checks exit 0 / table equality, or delete the duplicate.

title: a11y_reset/apply_demo_a11y leak-prevention is covered only incidentally, by demo run order
evidence:
a11y_reset(rc)
apply_demo_a11y(rc, &demo)
--- no direct test of reset semantics
detail: P3 gap. The harness run gate catches leaks only because a11y_* demos sort first alphabetically; reordering or single-demo runs skip the proof.
recommended_fix: Pin a11y_reset's output in a small unit test (mode Off, motion on, scale 1.0) or note the order dependency.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
